I'm telling you, Emily, breastfeeding is not as easy as everyone makes it out to be. I've been struggling to get little Jack to latch on properly and it's been a real challenge. Alright, Dad, I think we've got all the documents sorted out now. But I was thinking, have you considered scanning them and saving them to your computer? Oh, look, Rachel, the scenery is just breathtaking. I've never seen such beautiful mountains in my life. I'm so glad we decided to take this route from Białka Tatrzańska to Tarnow. I know, right? I've never seen a nest in that bush before. I'll have to keep an eye on it, make sure the eggs hatch alright. Oh, hello, boys! I brought some refreshments. Mmm, this is lovely. Thanks, dear. I'm glad you like it. So, what were you boys talking about? Birds' nests. Your husband here found one in his garden yesterday. Oh, that's lovely! I've always been fascinated by birds. I used to take the children on nature walks when I was a childminder, and we'd always look for birds' nests. Speaking of which, have you seen my old puppet collection? I used to use them to teach the children about different animals, including birds. Ah, yes! I remember those puppets. You used to have a whole collection of 'em, didn't you? What made you think of those? Oh, I don't know. I just love reminiscing about old times, I suppose. I'm so glad we decided to come to this restaurant, the view of the Mediterranean is just stunning. What do you recommend I try from the menu? Ah, you can't go wrong with the grilled halloumi, it's a Cypriot classic. And I'll have the same, with a side of village salad. How's your Greek been coming along, by the way? I know you've been trying to learn a few phrases. It's been a bit of a struggle, to be honest. I can manage to order food and ask for directions, but that's about it. I'm sure it'll come in handy. You know, I've always been fascinated by the cultural differences between the two sides of the island. Have you had a chance to explore much of Northern Cyprus yet? Not too much, we've only just arrived. But we're planning to do some hiking and visit some of the historical sites. And of course, we'll have to try some of the local cuisine. Speaking of which, have you tried that new restaurant in Kyrenia? I've heard great things about it. Actually, I have! It's one of my favorites. The owner, Mehmet, is a good friend of mine. He's a fascinating guy, very into spirituality and shamanism. He's even taught me a bit about dowsing. Really? I've always been skeptical about that sort of thing, but I've heard some interesting stories. Maybe one day I'll have to give it a try. By the way, how's your family doing? How's your sister coping with her illness? Ah, she's doing okay, considering. It's been a tough road, but she's a fighter. And how about your family? How's your mum doing? I know she's been having some trouble with her hearing lately. Yeah, she's been struggling a bit. She's just got a new hearing aid, though, so that should help. It's funny, I was talking to her the other day and she was saying how much she misses our old dog, Max. He was such a character.

Mum, I'm so glad we're finally catching up. I feel like I haven't seen you and dad in ages. How's everything been? Oh, you know, same old same old. Just busy with work and trying to keep the house tidy. Your father's been keeping me on my toes, as per usual. Hey, I'm not that bad! I've been helping out around the house, haven't I, dear? Oh, yes, you've been doing a wonderful job of making messes for me to clean up. Sounds like nothing's changed, then! So, how's work been, mum? Any new exciting things happening at the school? Actually, yes. We're in the middle of exams season, so it's been chaos. But I've been enjoying it. The kids have been doing really well, and it's lovely to see them achieve their goals. We've been trying out some new recipes, haven't we, dear? Yes, we have. Although, I have to say, your father's been getting a bit too fond of this one particular recipe for sausage rolls. Oh, dad! You and your love of sausage rolls! By the way, are you guys watching the rugby match this weekend? Of course, we are! We wouldn't miss it for the world. Although, I have to say, our team hasn't been doing too well lately... Oh, don't be such a pessimist, dear. They'll turn it around. And anyway, it's not just about winning or losing, it's about the excitement of the game. Exactly! I've been trying to get some of my friends into it, but they just don't get it. Maybe we can convert them this weekend.

Ey up, lasses! Ah've just been watchin' this programme about catfishin' on t'telly. It's mental, so it is! These people are gettin' tricked into thinkin' they're in a relationship wi' someone who's completely made up. Lah, I know what you mean! I've seen some of those shows, an' it's like, how can people be so gullible? I mean, I've 'ad me share of dodgy dates an' that, but at least I've met 'em in person, y'know? These catfish lot are just sittin' behind a screen, manipulatin' people's feelin's. I'm with you, girls. I was watchin' Jeremy Kyle the other day, an' they 'ad this segment on catfishin'. It was really eye-openin', actually. This one bloke 'ad been talkin' to this girl online for months, an' it turned out she was just some dude from Manchester or sommat. I felt so sorry for 'im, I did. Exactly! It's like, I get that people can be vulnerable an' all that, but come on, use yer 'ead! If someone's bein' all secretive an' won't meet up in person, there's usually a reason for it. An' don't even get me started on the ones who say they're in the army or sommat, but really they're just some nerd sittin' in 'is mum's basement. Oh, yeah! I've 'eard of those ones, too! An' it's always the same, innit? They're all like, "Oh, I'm a soldier, I'm fightin' for me country," an' really they're just fightin' for a decent Wi-Fi connection. But, you know, it's not just about bein' gullible or naive. Some of these catfish are really clever, an' they know exactly what they're doin'. They're like predators, preying on people's emotions an' vulnerabilities. It's really sad, actually. Aye, that's true. An' it's not just the people who are bein' catfished, either. Sometimes it's the catfish themselves who are troubled, y'know? Maybe they've got low self-esteem or sommat, an' they're just tryin' to fill a void or get attention. That's a good point, actually. I mean, I'm not sayin' it's excuse for their behaviour or anythin', but maybe if we understood why they're doin' it, we could...I don't know, help 'em or sommat.

Blimey, this pasta's lovely, innit? You're a genius in the kitchen, as per usual. Oh, thank you, dear. I'm glad you're enjoying it. I was thinking, since you're finishing up at university soon, we should plan a trip to Paris. You've always wanted to go, haven't you? Yeah, I've been dyin' to go to Paris! I've been studyin' French for years, and I'd love to put me skills to the test. But, I dunno, it's a bit pricey, innit? Maybe we could look into cheaper options, like hostels or somethin'? Well, actually, I was thinking we could stay with my cousin, Helga. She's been livin' in Paris for years, and I'm sure she'd be delighted to have us. Plus, she's fluent in French, German, and Italian, so we could practice our language skills with her. That sounds like a right ol' adventure! I'd love to meet Helga and practice me French. Speakin' of languages, how's your German comin' along? You were sayin' you wanted to brush up on it, weren't you? Ah, yes! I've been tryin' to get back into it, but it's not as easy as it used to be when I was livin' in Vienna. You know, I was thinkin' of takin' a class or gettin' a tutor to help me improve. Maybe you could even join me, dear? It'd be fun to learn together! I don't know, I'm not sure I'd be much help with German, but I could definitely give it a go. So, what made you want to learn German again? Is it because of your art? Well, yes, partly. I've been gettin' interested in Austrian art again, and I thought it would be lovely to be able to read about it in the original language. Plus, I've been thinkin' about visitin' Italy again, and I know some German would come in handy there too. Italy, eh? I've always wanted to go there too! You've told me so many amazin' stories about your time in Vienna and Italy. What's your favorite memory from when you were livin' in Italy? Oh, dear, there are so many to choose from, but I think one of me favorites is when I used to help out at a local bee farm.

I'm so glad we're finally on our way to Dorset, I've been looking forward to this trip for weeks. Although, I have to say, the traffic is already starting to get a bit crazy. Tell me about it, I've been driving for years and it's getting worse and worse. People have no idea how to drive safely anymore. I saw someone cutting off another car just a few minutes ago, it was terrifying. Oh, I know what you mean. I was driving to work the other day and someone ran a red light right in front of me. I had to slam on my brakes to avoid hitting them. It's just ridiculous. Exactly! And it's not just the driving, it's the road conditions too. There are so many potholes on this road, it's like they're trying to ruin our car's suspension. Ah, yes, the state of the roads is a nightmare. I remember when I was younger, the roads were always well-maintained and safe to drive on. Nowadays, it's like they're just patching things up as quickly and cheaply as possible. That's true. And have you seen the new building they're putting up near our house? It's this huge, ugly monstrosity that's completely out of character with the rest of the neighborhood. Ugh, don't even get me started on that. I think it's a real eyesore. And it's not just the aesthetics, I've heard it's going to cause all sorts of problems with traffic and parking in the area. Yes, I've lived in some rough towns in my time, but this one is definitely up there. I mean, have you seen the state of the high street? It's all pawn shops and charity stores. Well, at least we have our days off to look forward to. I'm so grateful to have a job that allows me to have a decent work-life balance. I don't know how people do it when they're working 12-hour shifts all the time. Absolutely. Although, I have to say, I'm a bit stressed out about this solicitor's bill I just got. I had no idea it was going to be so expensive. Ah, yes, solicitors can be a real rip-off. I had to deal with one a few years ago when I was trying to sort out some family business, and they just seemed to be taking me for a ride.

I'm tellin' ya, love, I've been thinkin' about me life a lot lately. Growin' up in Costessey, Norfolk, it was a different time, ya know? I never thought I'd be sittin' here, retired, with nothin' but me thoughts. Oh, come on, dear. You've had a good life. We've had our ups and downs, but we've always managed. And you've got me to keep you company, don't you? That's true, love. You've been me rock all these years. But sometimes I think about what could've been if I'd had a proper job, ya know? If I'd had a bit of stability and security. I feel like I've been a burden on the system, never workin' and whatnot. Nonsense, dear. You've done your best with what you had. And we've made do. We've had our little adventures, haven't we? Like that time we went to the seaside in Great Yarmouth? You were so proud of yourself for winin' that giant stuffed animal at the arcade. Ah, blimey, yeah! I remember that. I was chuffed to bits. But, serious though, love, I worry about the future. What's goin' to happen to us when we're really old? Who's goin' to take care of us? Well, we'll just have to take it one day at a time, won't we? We'll figure it out together. And we've got each other, that's the main thing. We're a team, always have been. Besides, I've been thinkin' about gettin' back into childminding, just a bit, to keep me mind active and earn a bit of extra cash. Oh, really? You think you're up for that? You've been retired for a while now, love. Are you sure you're ready to start lookin' after kids again? Well, why not? I'm not gettin' any younger, but I've still got plenty of energy. And it'll be good for me to get out of the house and meet new people. You can be me assistant, if you like. We can do it together. Me? Look after kids? I don't know, love. I'm not exactly the most patient bloke in the world. But, I suppose it could be a laugh. We can give it a go, eh? That's the spirit!

Ah'm tellin' ye, pet, that new album by Arctic Monkeys is canny good! Ah've had it on repeat aall day at work. What do ye think of it, like? You're always ahead of the curve, aren't you? I've only just started listening to it, but I can see why you like it. The lyrics are really clever. I've been meaning to ask, have you heard from Sarah lately? We haven't seen her in ages. Aye, ah spoke to her last week, and she's doin' all right. She's been busy with her new job, but we're plannin' on meetin' up soon. Maybe we can have a barbecue here, if the weather holds out. Speakin' of which, how's the garden comin' along? I've been meanin' to get out there and do some weedin', but I haven't had the chance yet. It's coming along, slowly but surely. I've been trying to get some more flowers to bloom, but it's been a bit of a challenge with this unpredictable weather. One day it's sunny, the next it's pouring rain. I swear, it's like the British summer is just a myth. Ah know, it's like that, int it? But we can't complain, really. At least we're not gettin' the heatwaves they're gettin' down south. Ah heard it's been terrible in London. How's your PhD goin', by the way? Are ye gettin' stuck into it? It's going, slowly. I've been reading a lot and trying to get my head around the theory, but it's a lot to take in. I'm just trying to stay focused and not get too overwhelmed. But it's good to have you to talk to about it, you know? You're always so organized and on top of things, it's inspiring. Ah'm just a nerd, pet. Ah love gettin' stuck into a good book or a project. But ah'm happy to help ye out in any way ah can. Now, shall we have some dessert? Ah made a treacle tart, and it's still warm from the oven. That sounds lovely, thank you. You're the best cook I know. And I'm not just sayin' that because I'm biased. Ah'm glad ye appreciate it, anyway! So, what do ye think we should do this weekend?

Ah'm tellin' ye, it's a right mess out there for young people lookin' for work. The unemployment rates are through the roof, pet. Ah've been readin' about it a lot for me research project at work. I know, it's shocking. I've been thinkin' about that a lot lately, especially with the university fees goin' up and up. It's like, how are people supposed to afford it? I feel lucky to be doin' me PhD, but at the same time, I'm worried about what'll happen when I finish. Exactly! And it's not just the fees, it's the lack of job opportunities afterwards. Ah've got mates who graduated with good degrees and they're still strugglin' to find work. It's like, what's the point of gettin' a degree if you're just gonna end up workin' in a shop or sommat? That's so true. I've got a friend who graduated with a degree in drama and she's now workin' as a waitress. She's still tryin' to make it as an actress, but it's tough. She's had to take on a part-time job just to make ends meet. Ah, that's a shame. She should get herself to London and try out for some musicals. Ah love a good musical, me. Ah've seen some crackin' shows in the West End. Have ye seen any good ones lately? Actually, yeah! Ah saw Les Misérables last year and it was amazing. The music, the acting, the whole production was just top-notch. Ah've been listenin' to the soundtrack nonstop since then. Ooh, ah love Les Mis! Ah've seen it a few times, and ah never get tired of it. Ah think it's because it's just so... emotive, ye know? The music gets ye right in the feels. Ah've been thinkin' about goin' to see The Phantom of the Opera next time ah'm in London. Ah, that's a great choice! Ah've heard it's a really impressive show. Ah've been meanin' to read the book actually, ah've heard it's really good. Maybe we can go see it together soon? That sounds like a plan, pet! Ah'd love to go see it with ye. Ah'll have to check me schedule and see when ah'm free. But anyway, back to the topic at hand... ah think the government needs to do more to support young people gettin' into work.

Mum, I've been thinking about writing a kids book and I wanted to get your opinion on it. I've been brainstorming some ideas and I think I've come up with something really cool. I've seen some really cool examples online. That sounds lovely. You know, I've been thinking about our family tree lately and all the interesting stories that have been passed down through the years. I've got a friend who's been separated from her partner for years, but they're still close for the sake of the children. Yeah, I know what you mean. My friend's parents are divorced, but they're still really close and they always make sure to spend time with him and his siblings. Exactly. And that's what's so important - that the children come first, no matter what the situation is. Anyway, back to your book, dear. What do you think about including some stories about different family styles?

Ah'm tellin' thee, I'm fair exhausted after that shift at t'library yesterday. I've 'ad no time to myself, what with studies an' work an' all. I know how you feel, babe. Ah feel like ah haven't seen yer in ages, we've both been so busy.

Alrigh' pet, how's the pint goin' down? I'm surprised ye can handle that much alcohol after a long day of researchin' at the university. Ah, it's goin' down just fine, thanks for askin', babe. I've had a long day of workin' on me PhD thesis, so I needed a break. By the way, have ye ever thought about the alphabets we use in our daily lives? But, I'm not entirely sure. I do know that they're crucial for communication, though. Without 'em, we wouldn't be able to write or read, would we? Exactly! And it's amazin' how we take 'em for granted. I mean, can ye imagine a world without alphabets? It's like, how would we even express ourselves? Alright, enough about that. What do ye say we get another round and talk about somethin' more interestin', like boxing? I've been followin' the sport closely, and I think it's really excitin'. Sounds like a plan, pet! I'm game for another drink. And, yeah, boxing's a great sport. I've always been a fan of Anthony Joshua. He's a brilliant boxer, and he's done a lot for the sport. But, have ye heard about the recent controversy surroundin' racism in football? It's absolutely disgustin' how some players are treated just because of their skin color. Ah, yeah, I've heard about it, and it's sickening. I mean, we're in the 21st century, and we still have to deal with this kind of nonsense. It's not just football, either – racism's a problem in all aspects of life. But, we should be proud of the progress we've made, and we should keep fightin' against it. By the way, have ye ever tried any of those new craft beers they have here? I've heard they're really good. Actually, I haven't, but I'm willin' to give 'em a try. I'm not a big fan of beer, but I'll drink it if it's good. So, what's the best one ye've had so far? And, speakin' of drinks, have ye ever tried any of those fancy cocktails they serve at that new bar downtown?

I'm telling you, Margaret, this project has the potential to be a real gem. The architecture of that old mansion is stunning, and with the right renovation, it could be a real showstopper. Alrigh' pet, how's it goin'? I've been thinkin' about me research on dialects and I had a crackin' idea for a new project. Alright kids, how was lunch at school today? Did you enjoy your meals? Yeah, it was okay. We had pizza and chips. But I didn't like the dessert, it was a fruit salad. I'm telling you, that film was a complete waste of time. I didn't expect much from the trailer, but it was even worse than I thought. The plot was all over the place and the acting was subpar. I'm tellin' ya, the weather's been gettin' worse every year. I remember when I was a lad growin' up in Costessey, we'd have proper summers with warm sunshine and cold winters with snow. I'm going to miss this route, you know? Driving from Mum's to your place has become a routine for me over the years. I know what you mean, son. It's always sad to say goodbye to familiar places. Alright, love, I think we've finalized the menu for your grandmother's birthday dinner. We've got the starter, main course, and dessert all sorted. What do you think about the seating arrangements? And while I'm there, I might pick up some of those nice artisanal breads she loves. Sounds like a plan. I was thinking we could also make some of those little pastry tart things she loves. Let's make a list and check it twice, like Santa Claus!

Ey up, ah'm gettin' a right headache wi' these wisdom teeth of mine. Ah've 'ad 'em comin' in for weeks now, an' it's drivin' me mad! Oh, I feel you! I had mine out last year, an' it was a nightmare. Ah'm stuck in me same old accommodation, but ah'm thinkin' of lookin' for a new place too. Maybe we can 'ave a look around together, an' see what we can find? Ah, that'd be great, thanks! Ah'd love to 'ave you come wi' me an' check out some places. An' maybe we can even find somewhere wi' a nice big garden, so we can 'ave a barbecue an' everyfing!

Alright kids, who's excited for Chinese New Year? We're going to make some delicious lactose-free cakes and cookies to celebrate. I am! I am! Mum, I'm so glad you're home. I had the craziest day at school today. I'm telling you, it's a nightmare trying to fight those planning applications for wind turbines. I was talking to the local group last night, and they're having the same issues we did. I'm telling you, learning to drive isn't as easy as it used to be. I got my license in just a few weeks, but nowadays it takes months. That's because the test is much more comprehensive now, Dad. Ah'm tellin' thee, it were a reight good do at t'anniversary party last weekend! Our whole family got together, and it were lovely to catch up wi' everyone. How did tha enjoy it, lad? Dad, I'm so excited for our holiday in Cornwall. I've been looking forward to it for weeks. How much longer until we get there? Ah, not too much longer, love. I'm telling you, the recent rise in racism in politics is just appalling. It's like we're taking steps backwards. Ah'm tellin' ye, the food in Italy was to die for! We went to this little trattoria in Florence and had the best pasta dishes ever. The chef even gave us a cookin' lesson, like. Ah, Italy, ye say? Alright, love, I think we've got our classes planned out for the next semester. I'm teaching Introduction to Linguistics and you're teaching British Literature, right? That's right. I'm telling you, this coffee machine is a nightmare. I've had it for years, but since I retired, I've had the time to really appreciate how temperamental it is. Ah, come on, Maeve. It's not that bad. Blud, I'm tellin' you, we should've brought some condiments from home. This Italian food is alright, but it's missing that extra somethin'. I know, right? Alright kids, settle down for a bit. We were talking about good versus evil, and I wanted to tell you some stories about legends and folk tales from around the world.
